package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for model_to_dto_mapping_in_handler: Handlers that manually shape every response from persistence structs rather than using dedicated mapping helpers.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type UserModel struct {
	ID        int
	FirstName string
	LastName  string
	EmailAddr string
	CreatedAt string
}

type UserResponse struct {
	ID    int    `json:"id"`
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Email string `json:"email"`
}

func GetUserHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user := UserModel{ID: 1, FirstName: "Alice", LastName: "Smith", EmailAddr: "alice@example.com", CreatedAt: "2024-01-15"}

	resp := UserResponse{
		ID:    user.ID,
		Name:  user.FirstName + " " + user.LastName,
		Email: user.EmailAddr,
	}

	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(resp)
}
